publication_type: repository-wide forensic doctrine review plus bilingual dedicated dossiers and site-wide route-specific module

controlling_proposition.es: Existe una pregunta forense unitaria sobre si las facultades confiadas a la Administración Concursal para LPB dejaron, en algún punto, de servir independientemente al interés de la concursada y empezaron a funcionar como mecanismo de implementación de objetivos de un perímetro privado adverso preexistente y de su posible sucesor económico. Cualquier consecuencia debe determinarse acto por acto.
controlling_proposition.en: There is a unitary forensic question whether powers entrusted to the insolvency administration for LPB ceased, at some point, to serve the debtor/estate independently and began functioning as a mechanism implementing objectives of a pre-existing adverse private perimeter and its possible economic successor. Any consequence must be determined act by act.

model.l5: functional/de facto adverse-agency hypothesis: evidence of knowing implementation of adverse objectives using administrator powers, without yet proving formal mandate or criminal agreement
model.l6: direct concerted-action evidence: instructions, representation, agreement, consideration, common planning or knowingly coordinated joint action
model.power_source_test: Was a power entrusted to the administrator for LPB/the estate used to produce an outcome the adverse actor could not itself lawfully produce?

legal_source_boundary.historic: Ley 22/2003 art.35 is used for historic loyalty/diligence/supervision framing.
legal_source_boundary.current: TRLC art.80 is used for current institutional continuity on diligence, insolvency interest, impartiality and independence; it is not retroactively substituted for historic law.

publication_safety.functional_agency: Forensic analytical label, not asserted standalone Spanish-law doctrine or established formal agency.
publication_safety.predecessor_to_cam: Possible economic/adoption continuity is investigated; legal succession is not assumed.
publication_safety.nullity: No global automatic nullity; consequences are act-specific and right-holder-specific.
publication_safety.dp1041: C5 direct causation is limited to AC termination of Cristo's specific formal LPB mandate; the withdrawal instruction/drafting/filing chain remains open.
publication_safety.downstream: HNT/MYND/RICPE/RIC/public-support positions are tested for dependency, not invalidated by association.

DP1041 withdrawal pleading and internal instruction chain.
Contemporaneous estate-benefit analysis for materially adverse-perimeter-benefiting AC acts.
Conflict disclosures, abstentions/recusals and judicial-supervision record.
Actor communication graph around 2017 credit acquisition, June 2018 and 2020-22 adjudication.
Evidence distinguishing coincidence/deference/negligence from knowing implementation and direct concerted action.
